title: Follow Kalman prediction and update
description: You trace each measurement into a stored state estimate and covariance.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You copy the prior state and covariance and allocate result arrays. Each loop first predicts x with F and propagates P with added process covariance Q.
You compute y, the measurement residual, and S, its covariance. The gain K weights that residual when updating x and P.

steps.question: Do xs and Ps store predictions before the measurement update or estimates afterward?
steps.answer: They store the updated estimates. The covariance is symmetrized immediately before storage.

steps.description: You initialize a four-entry state and diagonal prior covariance, then call the filter. The function returns one updated state and covariance per measurement row.
You print the shapes of the state and covariance arrays. The recorded result contains 30 four-entry state estimates with their covariance matrices.
